system.description: A wave of divine energy separates the wheat from the chaff in a 40' emanation around you. Whatever the result, you are Fatigued afterwards.

outcomes.success: Roll 4d6 once. Every foe in the area takes that much damage, and every ally regains that many HP instead. Undead and Fiends take double damage.
outcomes.ruin: The chaff is you: you gain two levels of Fatigued instead of one. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
